args: Activate the sleep-consolidate skill (RFC-0006 Nightly Dreaming): run ./bin/hq memory status, review today's turn journals in local/memory/journal/ and verify non-trivial or error turns with ./bin/hq memory verify-transcript <convId>, prune stale facts via ./bin/hq memory prune-fact, distill deep domain lessons into local/memory/topics/<slug>.md while keeping local/MEMORY.md <= 80 lines as a Roadmap Index, stage any skill proposals in local/memory/proposals/, and commit the private local/ Vault git repo.
description: Every night at 11:30 PM (America/Los_Angeles), verifies the day's turn journals against ground-truth transcripts, updates the Knowledge Wiki & Roadmap Index, prunes stale facts, and commits the private Vault.
